projects.title: Rebranding an interiors studio from logo to launch
projects.metricText: logo, website visuals and campaign creatives
projects.summary: Creative lead on the rebrand, from the first logo sketches to the website and social rollout.

case.sub: I led the Acme Interiors rebrand end to end, from the first logo sketches to website visuals and social campaigns.

brief.lead: The brief: rebuild the Acme Interiors identity and carry it across web and social.

process.intro: The rebrand moved through four phases. Each one narrowed the work from open questions to finished assets.
process.caption: The Double Diamond: diverge and converge on the problem, then on the solution.

challenge.text: How can Acme Interiors present one consistent identity across its logo, website and social channels, so every touchpoint feels like the same studio?

questions: Who is the brand speaking to, and what do they expect from an interiors studio?
Where does the current identity break down across web, print and social?
What should stay, and what should change?

outcomes.title: Delivered end to end
outcomes.text: I owned the rebrand from logo and identity to website visuals and campaign creatives.
